📖 [ STORY ]
Years ago, a group of scientists at IBC Laboratory accidentally invented a new biological weapon. The weapon was stolen after a leak of its existence. However, they were unable to contain the experiments. You have been tasked to investigate the places where the weapon was used. Team up with your friends to uncover the mysteries of Frigid Dusk.

- PC
- Mobile
- Console [ Lobby and Chapter 2.3 ]


⚙️[ RECOMMENDATION ]
 - Graphics settings at 4 +
 - High Brightness
